mira (People Ops): Hey new managers — quick orientation thread for this review cycle. TL;DR: checklist, extension rules, and who to loop in. :wave:

mira (People Ops): Important dates: peer feedback due 2026-03-31; manager reviews due 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT; calibration 04/13-04/17; ratings locked 04/24. Appeals window 04/24-04/29.

kevin (New Eng Manager): Thanks Mira. As a first-time manager, any templates or cheat-sheets for writing manager reviews?

ash (People Ops): Yes — two quick ones: (1) one-paragraph manager summary (strengths, delivered impact, growth area) and (2) 3-line calibration snippet for the notes field. Paste these into the form. Link: https://confluence.redwood/manager-review-templates

ash (People Ops): Extension policy quick: managers can request up to 48h for excused PTO/medical via the extension form. For longer or director-required signoffs, escalate to People Ops (reply here and we'll advise).

jess (Director, Product): For cross-functional contributors (design/sales embedded), should managers include peer context from other teams?

mira (People Ops): Absolutely — add one bullet with cross-team context and link to any joint PRs/OKRs. We also advise inviting the counterpart manager to calibration when the role crosses org boundaries.

kevin (New Eng Manager): One more: how do promotions interact with calibration?

ash (People Ops): Promotions are discussed separately but are surfaced during calibration if manager recommends. Add "promotion candidate" tag in the form and attach promotion packet link. People Ops will route to the promotions committee.

hr-bot: Reminder set: "New manager orientation: manager reviews due in 7 days" will DM new managers on 2026-04-03 10:00 PDT.

mira (People Ops): Final note: paste the one-paragraph summary + 3-line calibration snippet into each review, attach 1-2 evidence links, and RSVP to your calibration invite. DM us for any system glitches. :white_check_mark:
